t: AI vs. AI: A Debugging Saga from Philosophical Debate to Cross-Platform Triumph
s: This article chronicles a development process blending AI-assisted coding with philosophical discussions on AI intelligence. It details debugging a cross-platform issue using two AI instances, culminating in a human-AI collaborative release.
